definition: [ תְּשׁוּקָה ] noun feminine longing ; — of woman for man, אֶלאִֿישֵׁח תְּשׁוּקָתֵח Gen 3:16 ( J ); of man for woman, אֲנִי לְדוֺדִי וְאֵלַי תְּשׁוּקָתוֺ Song 7:11 of beast to devour, figurative אֵלֶיךָ תְּשׁוּקָתוֺ Gen 4:7 ( J ). ( ᵐ5 ἀποστροφή Genesis, ἐπιστροφή Canticles, whence Nes Marg. 6 proposes תְּשׁוּבָתֵךְ Gen 3:16 , which Ball Hpt reads in all; but how explain the unusual and striking word in MT?).
